استهجنوا (form X)
# اِسْتَهْجَنُوا (istahjanū) /is.tah.d͡ʒa.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
# اُسْتُهْجِنُوا (ustuhjinū) /us.tuh.d͡ʒi.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
# اِسْتَهْجِنُوا (istahjinū) /is.tah.d͡ʒi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
